comment: PBR description for hero_glass (C-13). 009 authors baseColor (including alpha), normal and roughness; the Q4 harness exercises a bounded screen-space transmission model over those inputs. Engine-side transmission remains unimplemented.
surface: pale frosted glass pane with a thicker, more opaque edge

transmission.why: the Q4 harness copies the pre-glass scene and composites a thin-slab screen-space refraction (IoR 1.5, 0.35 world-unit slab, five-tap frost) tinted by baseColor with a Fresnel environment reflection. The pane is excluded from the opaque shadow pass and does not write depth. Not modelled: dispersion, caustics, multiple internal reflections, per-layer depth rejection. Engine-side transmission is still not implemented.
transmission.alpha: authored in baseColor.alpha: 242 at the edge falling to 196 in the pane; the harness scales tint strength by alpha
transmission.evidence: specs/004-quality-renderer/evidence/t056/05-transmissive-environment.png vs 09-transmission-reference.png (corr 0.93, variance ratio 0.39, best background shift -9 px)

metalness.why: glass is a dielectric; no metal is modelled in this cell

ao.why: no baked AO authored for this cell; AO is not synthesised from the albedo
